children: RNS Number : 7239Z  Big Yellow Group PLC  21 October 2026
Big Yellow Group PLC, the UK's brand leader in self-storage, will be announcing its results for the half year ended 30 September 2026 at the close of the market on Monday, 16 November 2026.
There will be a presentation held for analysts and investors at 9am on Tuesday, 17 November.
